title: Booking and managing a test drive
summary: Create a dedicated test-drive booking, assign the customer, salesperson and demo vehicle, and manage confirmation, cancellation and no-shows.

body.text: The **Test drives** workspace is the source of truth for customer drives. Each booking is also linked to the existing activity calendar, so it remains visible alongside calls, meetings and follow-ups.

items: Choose **Book test drive**.
Select the customer and, where applicable, their open lead.
Set the branch or handover location, the requested model and the salesperson.
Assign an available demo vehicle now, or leave it unassigned until the vehicle is confirmed.
Set the start and expected-return times, then create the booking.

rows: The appointment exists but has not yet been confirmed.
The customer has confirmed the appointment.
The customer and vehicle passed the handover controls and the vehicle is checked out.
The vehicle returned and the outcome was recorded.
The appointment was cancelled with a reason.
The customer did not attend; an optional reason or note is retained.

body.text: The same demo vehicle cannot be booked for overlapping times. This is enforced both in the application and in the database, so simultaneous booking attempts cannot double-book it.

title: Driver checks, vehicle handover and return
summary: Complete the safety gate, record the vehicle's condition and evidence, then capture the return, incidents and sales outcome.

body.text: A vehicle cannot be checked out until every readiness item is complete. The checklist on the booking shows exactly what is still missing.

items: An available demo vehicle is assigned
The driver's licence number and a current expiry date are captured
A licence or ID image/PDF is uploaded
Identity is marked verified
The indemnity is signed, waived or marked not required
An emergency contact name and phone number are captured
At least one start-condition photo is uploaded
Record the start odometer and battery percentage.
Describe any existing damage and list the accessories supplied.
Capture the intended route or destination.
Choose **Check vehicle out**. The booking becomes Out on drive and the demo vehicle's latest odometer and battery state are updated.
Record the return odometer and battery percentage.
Describe the return condition and any new damage.
Record an incident report where necessary and upload supporting evidence.
Flag cleaning or charging work required.
Capture the customer's feedback and the sales outcome, linking the resulting quote where applicable.
Complete the return. The linked calendar activity is completed automatically.

body.text: Licence, identity and emergency-contact values are protected by record-level access controls. Licence and emergency-contact values are also redacted from audit JSON snapshots.

title: Demo-fleet availability and test-drive analytics
summary: Maintain dealership demo vehicles and interpret booking, attendance, conversion, utilisation and incident metrics.

body.text: The **Demo fleet** page records each dealership vehicle's model, stock-unit link, branch, registration, VIN, odometer, battery state and availability.

rows: Available to assign to new bookings.
Temporarily unavailable while work is performed.
Not bookable for another operational reason.
No longer part of the active demo fleet.

body.text: A vehicle that is currently out on a drive cannot be moved to maintenance, unavailable or retired until it returns.

rows: Unique new leads with a non-cancelled test-drive booking divided by accessible new leads in the period.
Drives that started divided by non-cancelled bookings.
Attended drives linked to a quote or marked quote/sale outcome divided by attended drives.
Attended drives marked Sale won divided by attended drives.
Scheduled drive hours divided by available active-demo operating hours.
Attended drives with new damage or an incident report divided by attended drives.
